package config

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestEnabledConstraints(t *testing.T) {
	opt := DefaultBuildOptions()
	require.NoError(t, opt.Validate())
	opt.Tags = []string{"fast"}
	require.Error(t, opt.Validate(), "disabled values must obey selection constraints")
	opt.Enabled = true
	require.Error(t, opt.Validate(), "the generated Enabled field can also govern required_when")
	opt.Label = "build"
	require.NoError(t, opt.Validate())
	require.NoError(t, (*BuildOptions)(nil).Validate())
}
